pages.text: Link the RH-5 to a power network with the Conduit Binder. No fuel, oxygen or Thermal Core is needed.

pages.title: Heat on Demand
pages.text: Each RH-5 draws up to 5 kW, matching an Iron Thermal Heater at full output. It draws only the heat needed for the default 20°C target or the room thermostat. Orange coils mean electrical heat is being delivered. Its screen shows room air, or structure temperature when no air is present.

pages.title: Backup and Brownouts
pages.text: Electrical heat runs before fuel heaters in the same modeled room; fuel covers any shortfall. PIXIE oxygen has priority over the heater. Lights and furnaces wait before heat does. A battery bank or isolated Cell Dock can keep it running until its cells drain. In vacuum, only 25% of paid heat couples into the structure. Insulation reduces steady demand.
